GeminiEvaluation is a configurable system. Before inferring, describing, or acting on evaluator behavior, read ChatMachines/GeminiEvaluation/README.md and the current ChatMachines/GeminiEvaluation/config.json. Do not infer current evaluator behavior from workflow names, runtime filenames, prior runs, or prior configurations. The current configuration is authoritative for the evaluator's present inputs, heuristic, output schema, history behavior, revision behavior, and output locations.

Construct the configured append-only corpus alignment addition. It must be exactly 271 Unicode code points including all leading separators or heading syntax, semantically non-normative, and suitable to append verbatim to the authoritative 60,929-character Agents.md so the projection totals exactly 61,200 characters.
